_comment: Upcoming Pokémon TCG drops. 'date' is ISO 8601 (Eastern). 'type' is 'online' or 'instore'. Real data last verified 2026-06-17 from pokemon.com & community trackers — update times/dates as retailers confirm. The bot reads this live.

drops.name: Mega Evolution: Pitch Black — pre-orders LIVE
drops.notes: Pre-orders opened June 10 and are live NOW (~37-day window, closing around the July 17 release). ETB, Booster Bundle & Booster Box available. The Pokémon Center ETB is exclusive: stamped Zarude illustration-rare promo + 2 extra packs. Also at Amazon/TCGplayer.

drops.name: Pitch Black — Pre-release events (local game stores)
drops.notes: Pre-release events run July 4–12 at participating stores — build a 40-card deck from a Build & Battle Box and play early. Digital cards hit Pokémon TCG Live on July 16.

drops.name: Mega Evolution: Pitch Black — worldwide release
drops.retailer: Pokémon Center / Target / Best Buy / Walmart
drops.notes: Main set launch. Features Mega Darkrai ex, Mega Zeraora ex, Mega Chandelure ex, Mega Excadrill ex. Available online and in stores the same day — be ready at open; popular boxes sell out fast. (Online drop time approximate.)

drops.name: 30th Celebration — worldwide simultaneous release
drops.notes: Huge anniversary set — the first-ever global same-day launch. Every card is foil, every pack includes a Pikachu (1 of 30 artists), plus 30 classic reprints (incl. Base Set Charizard) and a new 'Futuristic Rare' rarity. Expect heavy demand — line up at open.

drops.name: Premium Deck Set: Espeon & Umbreon
drops.notes: Launches the same day as 30th Celebration (Sept 16). Eevee-evolution collectors will compete with anniversary-set demand — plan accordingly.

drops.name: Storm Emerald (Mega Rayquaza ex) — English release [TENTATIVE]
drops.notes: ⚠️ TENTATIVE DATE — English release not officially confirmed. Japanese version drops July 31; English expected ~September based on typical delays. Headlined by Mega Rayquaza ex. Update this entry once the official date is announced.
